digest.component_or_area: rebar-debug skill documentation and ticket-handling workflow
propositions: Debug skill currently reads prior tickets but never writes back; Phase-1-exit RCA, reporting summary, and not-a-bug classification comments must be added at four lifecycle points with inline own-tracker-vs-third-party discriminator.
Existing approval-gate paragraph must be amended with carve-out sentence permitting own-tracker writebacks without gating while keeping all other tracker mutations gated.
Step 7 must decompose into two-axis sweep: construct-pattern axis (existing) and parity-sibling axis (new); entry trigger becomes OR of both conditions.

Step 7 parity-sibling axis must enforce 4-question artifacts (NAME THE RULE, CHANNEL CENSUS with 5-slot checklist, PER-SURFACE PROBE with path:line or MISSING, DISPOSITION) and discovered_from linkage stated inline without AGENTS.md reference.
Reporting must include residual-risk & prevention item with forced disposition (ticket filed, accepted with reason, fixed in scope, or none observed) stated as prose only.
All acceptance criteria verified and merged in Gerrit change 1291 with sync-gate regression (test_skill_shared_sync.py 5/5 green) and dry-run validation against 4b59 link-direction parity case.
